summary: Re-grill of the revised story-scoped-evidence contract (prior grill staled when plan_contracts C1/C2 were reworded). Three seams interrogated against the task contract, spec behaviour, and decision 0045; all resolved. No prior stages to assume against (task 1 is first).
current_flow: Recorders and gates resolve task-scoped artifacts by joining factory_dir(root) with hard-coded names; pr_ready later MOVES the set to .factory/history/<story>/. Overlapping stories write identical paths, so every overlapping PR conflicts; the move triggers cross-branch rename detection. Task 1 introduces story_dir()/evidence_path() so new-layout stories write under .factory/stories/<KEY>/ with legacy read-fallback.

criteria_map.the in-scope recorders (decomposition, g: test_new_story_artifacts_record_under_story_dir synthesizes a story under the new-layout marker and asserts each of the four in-scope recorders + verify writes/reads its artifact under .factory/stories/<KEY>/ through the single story_dir()/evidence_path() helper; a hand-joined path fails the gate
criteria_map.legacy live and history layouts remain r: test_legacy_layout_stays_readable_by_every_consumer replays a legacy live+history fixture and asserts the same consumers read the old paths unchanged (story-scoped-first, legacy-fallback on miss)

new_abstractions: story_dir(root, key) and evidence_path(root, key, name) in factory_lib - the single place layout knowledge lives; ad-hoc joins across the consumers are the fork risk. Reversible pure path resolution with legacy fallback.

resolutions: Per-story intake-time layout marker: writers go story-scoped only when the story dir/marker exists (created at intake, owned by migration-and-vendor); legacy stories incl. CFS-1 stay legacy end-to-end until re-intake, so no mid-story split. Task 1's required test synthesizes the marker to exercise story-scoped writes. Confirmed via AskUserQuestion 2026-08-18, consistent with the 2026-08-15 pre-draft decision.

Parked to owning tasks with revisit triggers (non-blocking for task 1): stages.json -> D-0027 (run-pointer/ship-in-place), outcome.json -> D-0028 (ship-in-place), briefs -> D-0029 (migration-and-vendor).

test_new_story_artifacts_record_under_story_dir parametrizes across all five consumers (decomposition/grill/test/review recorders + verify), asserting each routes through story_dir()/evidence_path(); a hand-joined path fails the gate.
